title: hotel-mgmt per-hotel configuration set (issue #158)
description: Validation shape for the section-2 set in docs/devops/deployment.md: hotel identity and local settings, standard times, rooms and capacity, rate plans, stay policies, charge items, tax and fee rules, stay restrictions, discounts, and the backup schedule with its retention floor. Enforced by script/validate-hotel-config.sh (called from script/preflight.sh before every install and upgrade, and from script/apply-hotel-config.sh before anything is applied): the set must be complete with no placeholder or malformed values — validation fails closed on defaults.

name.description: The hotel's own name; never the shipped example value.

propertyCode.description: The hotel's own property code; the EXAMPLE-001 placeholder is refused.

checkIn.description: The hotel's standard check-in time, 24-hour HH:MM (FR-CUS-2, FR-ADM-4).

checkOut.description: The hotel's standard check-out time, 24-hour HH:MM (FR-CUS-2, FR-ADM-4).

roomType.description: When present, must name a code from roomTypes so quotes resolve at install time.

requiredGuestFields.description: Hotel-mandatory guest fields (FR-CUS-1); must not be empty — no silent fallback to defaults.

cancellationReasons.description: The hotel's own cancellation reason list (FR-RES-3).

openBalanceCheckoutRule.description: Whether open-balance check-out needs approval and which role may approve (FR-BIL-7, BR-17).

retentionDaysFloor.description: Never below the 30-backup floor in docs/operations/backup-dr.md section 3.
